mechanism: Static-analysis-based context retention and call-graph-guided function-level translation within one migration
evidence_scope: LLMigrate uses static analysis to retain necessary context, pairs GPT-4o (a state-of-the-art LLM) with compiler-driven translation and program-repair techniques for complex core functions
evidence_role: we present LLMigrate, an LLM-based C-to-Rust translation tool that splits modules into dis- crete functions, translating them individually, and then reintegrating them.
